# Every machine gsm's examples make, checked by the extracted checkers in the
# oracle job (TestExampleMachinesGate, built with -tags gsmgate). See README.md.
#
# <program> <machine> <verdict>
#
# program: an Example function (any _test.go file in this directory), or the k-th
#   `gocheck: run` block of a document (README.md#1).
# verdict: certified         Build accepts it; both checkers verify it.
#          certified-tables  Build accepts it; the table checker verifies it. Its
#                            rules are closures, or it was verified by abstraction or
#                            per footprint component, so the rules checker does not run.
#
# machine: the registry name; a machine Build checked per footprint component is
#   listed once per component, as <name>/component<k>.
#          rejected          Build rejects it (WFC or CC); every checker that can
#                            run rejects it for the same reason.
#          synthesized       a synthesized repair; the table checker verifies it.
#          not-built         Build rejects it and nothing can be exported for
#                            the checkers (an invariant without a repair, left
#                            to synthesis).
#
# @none <program> <reason> lists an example that makes no machine.
#
# TestGateCatalogListsEveryExample fails when an example or run block is missing
# here; the gate fails when a listed program makes a machine not listed here, or
# a listed machine is not made.
